s2.ptxt: Install the distance control computer assembly with the bolt.

item.ptxt: Do not use a part that has been dropped or subjected to a strong impact during the work.
Route the hood lock cable on the vehicle inner side of the distance control computer assembly.

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 clips and 4 claws, and install the fuse box opening cover.

atten3.ptxt: When the distance control computer assembly has been replaced, be sure to perform the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Turn the cruise control main switch ON.
Depress the brake pedal. (Brake switch ON)
With the brake pedal depressed, push the cruise control main switch in the +RES direction 3 times within 3 seconds, and check that the buzzer sounds.

atten3.ptxt: Do not turn the headlight dimmer switch ON at this time. Because the automatic beam axis adjustment mode has been started, turning the headlight dimmer switch ON may cause adjustment with incorrect values. If the headlight dimmer switch is turned ON by mistake, perform beam axis adjustment.
